title: Evidence: Chair Mechanism Malfunction

attachments.platform_description:
30-second video demonstrating the tilt mechanism issue:

0:00-0:10 - Shows the tilt lock lever on the right side of the chair
0:10-0:20 - Demonstrates turning the tension knob under the seat clockwise
0:20-0:30 - Shows that despite adjustments, the chair does not lock in any tilted position - it freely swings back and forth

The tilt lock lever is engaged during the demonstration but does not prevent the backrest from moving freely.
